items.title: Five Faces Appoints Richard Alcock AO as Chair of the Board
items.description: Five Faces announces the appointment of Richard Alcock AO as Chair of the Board and Non-Executive Director.

items.title: Webinar: Co-Designing Digital Healthcare with Rural and Remote Communities
items.description: RFDS SA & NT and Five Faces explore how stakeholder engagement and community consultation helped shape the design and rollout of the Bushlink digital booking portal.

items.title: Why Healthcare Interoperability Matters for Patient Engagement
items.description: Learn how healthcare interoperability improves patient engagement, streamlines communication, & supports better healthcare experiences.

items.title: Reducing Surgical Cancellations with Digital Preoperative Workflows
items.description: Surgical cancellations are predictable - and preventable. See how digital preoperative workflows connect systems, engage patients, and reduce day-of-surgery risk.

items.title: SMS vs Email for Patient Comms in Healthcare: A Decision Guide
items.description: SMS vs email in healthcare: learn when to use each, why SMS-first models are becoming standard, and how to build a secure patient communication strategy.

items.title: Five Faces Deploys Patient Check-In and Queueing at Peninsula University Hospital
items.description: Five Faces has deployed a Patient Check-In and Queueing solution for ambulatory care appointments at Peninsula University Hospital in Frankston, Melbourne.

items.title: Five Faces Launches Patient Journey Support for Complex Care, Starting with Surgery
items.description: Five Faces has launched Patient Journey Support, a new solution designed to help health services guide patients through complex care – beginning with perioperative services.

items.title: The Clinician’s Dilemma: Digital Health and the Hidden Cost of Waiting for Change
items.description: When digital health can’t keep up with care, clinicians pay the price. This article looks at the hidden cost of waiting for change in healthcare systems.

items.title: Digitising Perioperative Care: A Better Experience, Not Just a Digital One
items.description: This article outlines how many health services operate today and what an optimised, digital-first approach can look like, from consent to recovery.

items.title: What Is a Digital Front Door in Healthcare? Benefits, Strategy & Real-World Examples
items.description: This article explores what a digital front door entails, its benefits, and real-world examples showcasing success in action.
